_comment: ROAD-VISUAL-CREATURES 2026-09-07. Authored ordinary colourways for the 32 installed later-biome meshes. Sources: Cloudreach/Stormwood roster boards and docs/art/BIOME_2_3_4_CREATURE_ROSTER.md; Water presentation_intent fields in water_roster.json. These are region repaints of each embedded source albedo, not whole-model tints and not generated assets. Strong primary blocks carry identity at road distance; brighter low-saturation source regions become a restrained contrasting accent. Geometry, roster role and species mapping are unchanged.

pebbik._comment: The installed source already paints the owner board's warm tan body, cream face/chest, blue feather tips and dark eye. The previous broad rules collapsed those anatomical regions into neon yellow and purple. Preserve the source grouping, cap only excessive chroma, and keep its existing facial value hierarchy instead of restamping dark fur noise as features.

craghorn._comment: The installed source already matches the owner board's white-and-grey shaggy cliff goat with dark horns and restrained warm ears. The previous orange/cyan rules introduced artificial speckling and shifted neutral fleece. Preserve the authored regions and cap only excessive chroma.

stormcapra._comment: The installed source already matches the owner board: a white and charcoal armoured ram with sparse blue crystal breaks and warm eye/horn detail. The previous global azure remap turned both coat and armour into one saturated blue mass. Preserve the authored material regions and restrain only excess chroma.

skyrill._comment: The installed Skyrill mesh is a broad, winged sky-drake rather than the board's compact sail-backed cliff lizard, so a one-hue cyan repaint makes the mismatch worse: it erases the source atlas's blue, coral and cream anatomy and leaves no face at gameplay distance. Preserve that authored regional hierarchy, cap only its hottest chroma, lift the narrow forward head plane, and deepen dark marks only inside that plane. This is a subject-specific presentation repair, not a claim that paint can replace the board silhouette.

aeriex._comment: The installed source already carries the owner board's cream body, teal flight feathers and coral-orange tips. The previous violet/cyan remap erased the face and flattened all three anatomical regions into magenta. Preserve the source grouping and cap only its strongest chroma.

ribbonray._comment: The installed source already carries the owner board's layered purple and blue ribbons, warm cream underplanes and a small blue/cream face with a black eye. The previous broad magenta rule collapsed that hierarchy into one pink silhouette. Preserve the authored regions while restraining only the hottest chroma.

breezetail._comment: The installed source already matches the owner board's natural brown-and-cream wind-runner, with blue feathered tail accents and readable dark eyes. The previous coral remap replaced fur values and facial contrast with a flat orange-red body. Preserve the source grouping and restrain only excess chroma.

cloudfang._comment: The installed source already matches the owner board's white and pale-blue cloud wolf with grey shadow planes and bright blue eyes. The previous cobalt rule over-saturated the accent fur and reduced the value hierarchy. Preserve the source grouping and restrain only excess chroma.

cliffspike._comment: The installed source already matches the owner board's tan, cream and grey cliff porcupine with dark blue-grey quill shadows and black eyes. The previous amber/blue rules flattened it into a bright gold body. Preserve the authored fur and quill regions and cap only excess chroma.

tempestwing._comment: The installed source already paints the owner board's deep-blue body, pale blue-and-gold wings and dark segmented detail. The previous violet/cyan remap made every flight surface fluorescent purple and destroyed the wing hierarchy. Preserve the source grouping and cap only excessive chroma.

solmane._comment: The installed source already matches the owner board's warm gold-and-cream winged lion with restrained teal-dark feather edges. The previous solar remap pushed the complete animal to near-neon yellow and erased its face and feather structure. Preserve the source grouping and restrain only excess chroma.

voltwig._comment: The installed source already matches the board's green branch gecko, cream underside, leaf growth and large amber eyes. The former orange/cyan rules erased that botanical identity. Preserve the source regions and restrain only excess chroma.

glimmermoth._comment: The installed source already matches the board's cream moth, violet-blue patterned wings, gold guides and large blue eyes. The former magenta treatment flattened the wing pattern and face into one pink body. Preserve the authored regions and cap only excessive chroma.

stormbrush._comment: The installed source already matches the board's dark brown and white badger with blue lightning fur. The former amber/violet treatment turned the animal gold and pink. Preserve the source coat, mask and charge regions and restrain only excess chroma.

mosshock._comment: Mosshock's installed atlas has the correct broad newt anatomy and cream belly but uses lava-red dorsal growth unlike the owner board's mossy green creature. Repaint only those authored chromatic growth regions: red becomes moss green and warm gold becomes yellow-green current, while neutral belly, dark structure and amber eyes remain source-authored.

staticub._comment: The installed source already matches the board's natural brown storm cub, cream muzzle, blue eyes and restrained violet lightning. The former electric-blue rule flattened the complete coat. Preserve the source hierarchy and restrain only excess chroma.

tanglevolt._comment: The installed source already matches the board's charcoal-and-white storm wolf with violet lightning and blue eyes. The former yellow/green treatment erased the wolf's mask and coat hierarchy. Preserve the authored regions and restrain only excess chroma.

stormraven._comment: The installed source already carries the board's deep indigo-black raven, blue storm striations and bright blue eye. The former royal-purple remap collapsed feather values into one synthetic hue. Preserve the source feather hierarchy and cap only excessive chroma.

thundertunnel._comment: The installed source already matches the board's charcoal storm mole with pale claws and muzzle, black eyes and violet-blue charge lines. The former orange treatment erased those regions. Preserve the source grouping and restrain only excess chroma.

voltarach._comment: The installed source already carries the owner board's charcoal shell, warm amber/gold edge planes and clustered blue facial nodes. The previous broad ordinary rules erased that hierarchy into a hot-magenta mass that the combined biome judge singled out. Preserve and restrain the source grouping for ordinary wildlife. The active alpha remains a separate storm-indigo/cyan treatment: the owner explicitly rejected the prior pink alpha, and runtime prefers the authored alpha texture over the vivid fallback.

fulgocobra._comment: The installed source already matches the board's legendary charcoal serpent, cream throat and cracked gold lightning seams. The former yellow/violet remap made the complete cobra fluorescent chartreuse. Preserve the source scales and throat hierarchy and restrain only excess chroma.

cannonback._comment: Water roster intent: slate shell, cream belly, ochre rim.

riptusk._comment: Water roster intent: slate hide, ivory tusks and ochre spines. The installed source already paints those anatomical blocks; the previous broad coral rule replaced nearly all of them with one hot hue. Keep the source grouping, cap only its strongest chroma, lift the small forward face plane, and recover its darkest eye/mouth marks only inside that face instead of re-stamping dark speckles across the body.

aquaryn._comment: Water Alpha: radiant cyan body and ceremonial gold planes.

tidecoil._comment: Deep violet tide serpent with cyan current markings.

mirejaw._comment: Water roster intent: spotted charcoal/taupe body with muted coral gills. Those regions are already present in the installed source; the previous broad magenta rule flattened both into a black-and-pink mass. Preserve the source grouping, restrain its chroma, lift the forward muzzle, and recover dark eyes/mouth only inside that face instead of amplifying every body spot.

torrentoad._comment: The installed source already separates a slate-blue wet back, pale throat and restrained warm markings. The previous broad orange/teal rules flattened those anatomical blocks and made its already-recessed facial forms harder to locate. Preserve the source grouping, cap only the strongest chroma, and lift the forward upper face plane without inventing replacement eye paint: a bounded anatomy-predicate eye attempt landed as vertical cheek stripes and was rejected. The paired attack source correction grounds every sampled pose, but the mesh's eye/silhouette gap remains an asset-level follow-up.

cragclaw._comment: Water roster intent: rust claws, grey stone and moss shell. The installed source already separates all three, while the previous signal-red first match erased that hierarchy. Preserve the source grouping, restrain only its strongest chroma, lift the narrow central face plane, and recover the dark eye marks only there instead of deepening shell speckles.

riverdrake._comment: River cyan body with orange fin/plate contrast.

sirenseal._comment: Water roster intent: ivory throat, slate body and dusty lilac fins. The installed source already carries that large face/throat block; the previous coral rule turned the whole silhouette hot pink. Preserve the source grouping, cap the blue fins below neon, and lift the upper face while retaining its source eye marks.

mangrove_monitor._comment: Water roster intent: olive mottling, ochre face stripe and dark bark body. The installed source already paints those regions; the previous sun-gold rule collapsed them into one glaring yellow mass. Preserve the source grouping, restrain its strongest chroma, lift the forward upper face, and recover only the dark eye marks there.

abyssal_guardian._comment: Legendary indigo giant with hot magenta abyssal planes.
